topic: Skeletal muscle excitation contraction and relaxation
user_request: For grades10-12, explain how an excitation of a vertebrate skeletal muscle fibre leads to contraction and then relaxation. Establish the necessary participants, causal steps, initial conditions and recovery states from independently retrieved sources. Do not replace the requested mechanism by a generic movement description. Molecular atomic detail is unnecessary, but required causal intermediate steps must not be omitted.
